name: PromotionCalendarPlanner
tagline: Plan, approve and launch every promotion from one calendar – clashes, lead times, ROI and store readiness in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete retail promotion calendar: plan promo periods by category, mechanic and store cluster on a 6–26 week timeline; check lead time, blackout dates, discount limits, ROI on incremental sales and supplier funding and category or Hero clashes; run the approval pipeline from draft to live with role rules and a four-eyes check; track store readiness item by item and store by store. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: 6, 13 or 26-week calendar by category with stacked lanes, today line and blackouts
Drag a draft to new dates – the rules are re-checked
Lead time (longer for Hero), blackout, discount and ROI rules
Category clash and Hero clash detection
Approval pipeline with drag and drop, reasons and a four-eyes rule
Store readiness checklist and stores-ready count with due dates
Forecast, incremental sales, markdown cost, supplier funding and ROI per promotion and per week
Bulk submit, approve, go live and cancel
Copy a promotion to next year
Undo, CSV export and printable store brief
Power Fx outputs and events (PromoBriefText, SummaryJson)
